title: Certificates of Deposit: bump-up rate option by tier
content:
## Scope

This card covers the bump-up option of the Certificates of Deposit line, under which the owner may ask for the certificate's rate to be raised during a term, and states for every tier how many such requests are allowed per term and within how many calendar months after the term start date a request is accepted.

## Definitions

- **Rate increases per term** is the number of rate increases the owner may request per term, as a count.
- **Bump-up window** is the number of calendar months after the term start date within which a bump-up request is accepted, or "not applicable".

## Settings by tier

| Tier | Rate increases per term | Bump-up window (calendar months after the term start date) |
|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 0 | Not applicable |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 0 | Not applicable |
| 12-Month Certificate | 0 | Not applicable |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 1 | 15 |
| 36-Month Certificate | 0 | Not applicable |
| 60-Month Certificate | 0 | Not applicable |

## Points of judgement

**Can the owner of a 36-Month Certificate ask for a higher rate after rates rise?**
No. The 36-Month Certificate allows 0 rate increases per term, and its bump-up window is not applicable. The same is true of every tier except the 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate.

**How many times per term may the owner of an 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate ask?**
Once: that tier allows 1 rate increase per term, within 15 calendar months after the term start date.

**Does the window run to the end of the term?**
No. On the 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate the window is 15 calendar months after the term start date, while the term itself is longer, so the last months of the term fall outside the window.
